name: mspm0c1103
description: TI MSPM0C1103 (Cortex-M0+, 24 MHz, 8 KB flash, 1 KB SRAM; C1104: 16 KB flash): GNU Arm toolchain with the MSPM0 SDK, Renode MSPM0 models

image.notes: load the ELF ({kind: elf}) to get the symbols, or the LoadBinary images of build_firmware. Sources use the SDK headers (#include <ti/devices/msp/msp.h>, DriverLib <ti/driverlib/driverlib.h>).

renode.notes: Pins: 'iomux PinLevel <n>' (PA n = n, PB n = 32 + n), 'iomux RecordPin <n>' then 'iomux PinEdges/PinFrequency/PinDuty <n>'; external pin level: 'iomux OnGPIO <n> true'. ADC inputs: 'adc0 SetChannelVoltage <ch> <V>'. Without a debugger __BKPT escalates to HardFault (exception 3), as on the device. Peripheral notes: tools/mspm0/PERIPHERALS.md. MSPM0C1104 / LP-MSPM0C1104: platforms/cpus/ti/mspm0c1104.repl, platforms/boards/ti/lp_mspm0c1104.repl (use -D__MSPM0C1104__ and mspm0c1104.lds).

reference.simulator: none; peripheral models checked with the MSPM0 SDK DriverLib examples (tools/mspm0/run_examples.py and the examples_*.txt specs in the Renode tree)
